## Definition of Done
Every PR MUST satisfy [`docs/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md`](../docs/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md) (or explicitly mark non-applicable items as N/A with a brief justification) before its issue moves to Done.
Tests travel with the change in the same PR, never as a follow-up TODO.

## Checkboxes de criterios de aceptación
Antes de cerrar una issue (moverla a Done), todos sus checkboxes de criterios de aceptación deben estar marcados `[x]`.
Márcalos a medida que cada criterio se verifica, no todos al final de golpe.
